items.headline: Aidan Chiles throws for 3 TD, runs in 2 more, and No. 24 Northwestern beats Rutgers 42-14
items.description: — Aidan Chiles threw for three touchdowns for the third time this season and rushed for two others to lead No. 24 Northwestern past Rutgers 42-14 on Saturday for a fourth straight victory.

items.headline: Rutgers QB Dylan Lonergan exits with apparent head injury
items.description: Rutgers QB Dylan Lonergan will not return to Saturday's game at Northwestern after suffering an apparent head injury on a big hit, coach Greg Schiano said.
